portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
The hwdata package contains tools for accessing and displaying hardware
identification and configuration data, such as the pci.ids and MonitorsDB
databases.

This updated package adds the following enhancements:

* The MonitorsDB database has been updated to add the following:
3 ACER monitors
656 LG monitors
2 NEC monitors
1 OKI monitor
Additionally, 12 Acer monitors were duplicated in the database; listed both
under their model name and under the name of their driver for Microsoft
Windows operating systems. The latter entries have been removed. Some
existing entries in the database were updated to indicate the availability
of DPMS support.

* PCI IDs have been added for the following devices:
Atheros AR5006EX 802.11abg wireless NIC
Broadcom NetXtreme 10Gigabit PCIe controllers
Cisco PCIe 10G Ethernet NICs
Cisco PCIe downstream port bridges
Cisco PCIe FCoE HBAs
Cisco PCIe upstream port bridges
HP NC522m Dual Port 10GbE Multifunction BL-c Adapter
HP NC375i Integrated Quad Port Multifunction Gigabit Server Adapter
HP NC522SFP Dual Port 10GbE Server Adapter
Intel 82576EB gigabit ethernet controller
Intel Ibex Peak HECI controllers
Intel Ibex Peak High Definition Audio
Intel Ibex Peak KT controllers
Intel Ibex Peak LAN controllers
Intel Ibex Peak LPC interface controllers
Intel Ibex Peak PCI Express root ports
Intel Ibex Peak PT IDER controllers
Intel Ibex Peak SATA AHCI controllers
Intel Ibex Peak SATA Enhanced RAID controllers
Intel Ibex Peak SATA IDE controllers
Intel Ibex Peak SATA RAID controllers
Intel Ibex Peak SMBus controllers
Intel Ibex Peak thermal subsystem
Intel Ibex Peak USB universal host controllers
Intel Ibex Peak USB2 enhanced universal host controllers
Intel Ibex Peak VECI controllers
Intel PRO/Wireless 5100 network adapters
Netxen 10 Gigabit Ethernet PCIe adapters
Netxen BladeCenter-H 10 Gigabit Ethernet High Speed Daughter Card
Netxen Dual Port 10GbE Multifunction Adapter for c-Class
Netxen management interface
Netxen NX3031 Multifunction 1/10 Gigabit Server Adapter
Sun multithreaded 10G ethernet controllers

Users of hwdata are advised to upgrade to this updated package, which adds
these enhancements.
